notes.title: Patch Note 12.16.2017
notes.content:
Dear players, we thank you for your patience and your kindness,
we made this last fix with your feedbacks and hope you will now get the experience we hoped with Z-End. We know we have made some (a lot?) of mistakes and are trying to make adjustments.
Here is the list of fixed/adjusted features with this last patch:


Improvment of english translations
You should not encounter any freeze of the story whatever path you choose from now on.
Fixed a bug that could change the sex of the player during dialogs
Fixed a bug that would freeze the game when a timed choice shoud be displayed
 Added an Ending screen that reflects your choice and give a hint on other paths 
Fixed some achievments that used to not trigger


We again apologize for any inconvenience encountered from the launch of our game and hope you will enjoy this new stable version of Z-End.

notes.title: Patch Note 12.14.2017
notes.content:
Fixed bugs that used to change the gender of the player during dialog
 Some timed choices used to freeze game, they should now behave normally
 The player alignment at the end of the game should now match your choices
